subject: pathology
title: Diseases of infancy and childhood: malformations, infections and tumours

steps.tx: Childhood pathology clusters into congenital malformations, complications of prematurity, infections and tumours that differ from adult cancers. **Malformations** arise from intrinsic developmental errors during organ formation in early embryonic life before birth. Disruptions destroy structures that had formed normally, while deformations mould normal tissue through mechanical forces inside the uterus. **Sequences** cascade from one initiating defect, so a single early abnormality produces several downstream structural consequences in infants.
steps.say: Childhood disease is different because malformations, prematurity complications and embryonal tumours dominate instead of degenerative adult diseases. Malformations occur because intrinsic developmental programmes fail during early organ formation in the embryo before birth. Deformations are mechanical because external forces mould structures that had initially formed normally inside uterus.

steps.tx: Premature lungs lack surfactant, so alveoli collapse and **respiratory distress syndrome** develops soon after birth in preterm infants. Atelectasis causes hypoxia, while fibrin and necrotic debris line alveoli as pink **hyaline membranes** on microscopy sections. Antenatal steroids mature surfactant production before delivery, and exogenous surfactant rescues established disease after birth in neonatal units. Retinopathy of prematurity and necrotising enterocolitis complete the classic prematurity complications that examiners rotate through papers.
steps.say: Respiratory distress syndrome is a disease where surfactant deficiency causes alveolar collapse immediately after preterm birth occurs. Hyaline membranes form because fibrin and necrotic debris line injured alveolar walls in struggling preterm lungs. Antenatal steroids help clinicians mature fetal lungs before delivery when preterm birth threatens.

steps.tx: This neonatal lung section shows thick pink **hyaline membranes** lining an airspace beside collapsed dark atelectatic lung tissue nearby. That appearance explains **respiratory distress syndrome** because surfactant deficiency lets alveoli collapse while injured walls leak fibrin rich fluid. The membrane itself is not infection, but fibrin and necrotic debris coating alveolar surfaces in preterm lungs after birth. Examiners pair this histology with prematurity, grunting and hypoxia that improve after surfactant treatment in neonatal stems.
steps.say: This lung section is showing hyaline membranes because fibrin rich material lines alveolar walls in surfactant deficient preterm lungs after birth. Atelectasis appears nearby because collapsed alveoli cluster where surfactant is absent and surface tension stays high constantly. This histology helps clinicians connect prematurity with immediate respiratory distress in newborn stems.

steps.tx: **Necrotising enterocolitis** causes ischaemic necrosis of preterm bowel, especially terminal ileum and proximal colon, during early feeding. Immature mucosal barrier, formula feeding and bacterial colonisation converge and injure the vulnerable preterm intestinal wall severely. Babies develop feed intolerance, abdominal distension and **pneumatosis intestinalis**, where gas collects inside the necrotic bowel wall on imaging. Perforation requires surgical resection, although surgery risks short bowel syndrome when extensive intestine is removed later.
steps.say: Necrotising enterocolitis is a disease where preterm bowel becomes necrotic after feeding starts in neonatal intensive care. Pneumatosis appears because gas producing bacteria invade the injured bowel wall and dissect within its layers visibly. Feed intolerance helps clinicians suspect disease early before perforation forces emergency surgery.

vis.alt: Diagram of preterm bowel with necrotising enterocolitis, showing gas bubbles (pneumatosis intestinalis) in the necrosed, thickened bowel wall.
vis.caption: Necrotising enterocolitis: ischaemic necrosis with pneumatosis intestinalis

steps.tx: Childhood tumours are often embryonal small blue cell neoplasms that arise from developmental tissues in young children. **Neuroblastoma** arises from adrenal or sympathetic tissue, secretes catecholamines and may show opsoclonus myoclonus in some children. **Wilms tumour** forms a triphasic renal mass with blastemal, epithelial and stromal elements under the microscope. Retinoblastoma follows RB1 loss, hepatoblastoma raises AFP, and leukaemia remains the commonest childhood cancer overall in practice.
steps.say: Neuroblastoma is an embryonal tumour that arises from sympathetic tissue and secretes catecholamines into urine and blood measurably. Wilms tumour is different because triphasic renal histology combines blastema with epithelial and stromal elements microscopically. Childhood cancers are embryonal because they recapitulate developing tissues rather than adult carcinomas.

left.title: Neuroblastoma
points: Adrenal or sympathetic chain, calcified, crosses midline
Stage 4S in infants may regress spontaneously

right.title: Wilms tumour
points: Large renal mass, usually unilateral, does not cross midline like neuroblastoma imaging

steps.tx: **Sudden infant death syndrome** remains a diagnosis of exclusion after autopsy, death scene investigation and history review reveal no cause. It affects infants under one year and associates with prone sleep, soft bedding and overheating during sleep periods. Vulnerability in brainstem arousal development likely interacts with these environmental stresses during a critical developmental window in infancy. **Back to sleep** campaigns reduced incidence dramatically because supine sleeping removes a major modifiable risk factor for infants.
steps.say: Sudden infant death is a diagnosis where investigation finds no cause after autopsy and scene review are completed thoroughly. Prone sleeping increases risk because vulnerable brainstem arousal responses fail during sleep in affected infants unknowingly. Supine campaigns helped populations because removing prone sleep reduced deaths without fully explaining mechanism.
